rationale: Official project evidence identifies B46 Local and Select Bus Service as beneficiaries of the Malcolm X Boulevard/Utica Avenue bus-lane project, preserving one nonterminal project-corridor context. It does not bind B46+ to the exact three ordered southbound feature rows, their 2020-07-23 registry day, stable phase identity, or candidate-date traversal; every exact row has an empty SBS array and the historical path is unavailable. Attribution and traversal remain unresolved. The existing canonical corridor relation is not an occurrence and no correction, occurrence, study, or cross-product projection is authorized.
